Theming

Every widget reads its colors from the theme. Call initializeTheme() once, before any widget renders, to customize the default behavior. 

// Initialize the theme with a custom color
initializeTheme({ color: "gray", center: true });

Press Ctrl+K to open the color picker. The sample output looks like color: gray.

Options

OptionDefaultWhat it does
color"gray"The color used for borders and dividers.
centerfalseCenters the label in the widget.

Try it

Type a color name here, like gray.

The ColorPro Studio plugin adds a palette of favorite colors.
